facts.text: The resort is located in UNESCO's first Southeast Asia Geopark, renowned for its 99-island archipelago.
facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Langkawi is located in UNESCO’s first Southeast Asia Geopark renowned for its 99-island archipelago

facts.text: The resort is located at the southeast tip of the island, surrounded by centuries-old rainforest.
facts.excerpt: Located at the Southeast tip of the island surrounded by centuries-old rainforest

facts.text: The resort sits on the largest lagoon with a 600-meter white sand beach overlooking the Andaman Sea.
facts.excerpt: sits on the largest lagoon with a 600-meter white sand beach overlooking the emerald green waters of the Andaman Sea

facts.text: The hotel has four over-water villas: three Sunset Overwater Villas and the Sunset Royal Villa, each with a private terrace and infinity pool.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel's three Sunset Overwater Villas and the Sunset Royal Villa each boast a private terrace and infinity pool

facts.text: The Sunset Over-Water Villa has separate living and dining rooms, a kitchenette and a walk-in wardrobe.
facts.excerpt: Complete with separate living and dining rooms, kitchenette and a spacious walk-in wardrobe

facts.text: All rooms offer unobstructed views of the sea from terraces.
facts.excerpt: All rooms offer expansive, unobstructed views of the sea from spacious terraces.

facts.text: Rooms feature bold accent hues and paintings by local artists.
facts.excerpt: distinct in design with bold accent hues and imaginative paintings by esteemed local artists

facts.text: Interiors were designed by G.A Design and the architecture by Gensler, with a classical contemporary aesthetic with European and Middle Eastern influences.
facts.excerpt: Interiors at our Langkawi resort with 5 stars were designed by G.A Design and architecture by renowned firm Gensler, channeling a classical contemporary aesthetic with European and Middle Eastern influences.

facts.text: Kayuputi is the over-water restaurant, designed as an art collector's beach house, serving pan-Asian inspired cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Kayuputi is designed as an art collector's beach house. Enjoy fine pan-Asian inspired cuisine

facts.text: L'Orangerie is a beachfront restaurant presenting a fusion of modern French cuisine and Asian flavours.
facts.excerpt: L'Orangerie, our beachfront Langkawi restaurant​, presents a fusion of modern French cuisine and vibrant Asian flavours

facts.text: Pantai Grill serves seafood dishes and steaks cooked over a wood-fire grill.
facts.excerpt: boasts a menu of premium seafood dishes and steaks cooked over a wood-fire grill

facts.text: The St. Regis Bar serves the Lang Mary, a twist on the Bloody Mary named after the 'island of the reddish-brown eagle' in Malay.
facts.excerpt: Try the Lang Mary, an exotic twist on the iconic Bloody Mary, named after the "island of the reddish-brown eagle" in Malay.

facts.text: The St. Regis Bar features an installation of banyan tree bark, sculpted trunks and suspended leaves set against a granite wall.
facts.excerpt: featuring an expansive installation of banyan tree bark, sculpted trunks, and suspended leaves set against a granite wall

facts.text: The St. Regis Bar has a live band each evening.
facts.excerpt: accompanied by the smooth rhythms of our live band each evening

facts.text: The Decanter wine bar is a space for savoring rare vintages.
facts.excerpt: The Decanter wine bar is an intimate and refined space where connoisseurs can savor the pleasures of rare vintages.

facts.text: Afternoon tea is served in the Drawing Room in the lobby, with fine teas and classic sweets and savouries with a local twist.
facts.excerpt: offers guests an exquisite selection of fine teas along with classic sweets and savouries with a local twist. Available daily from 3:00 PM – 5:00 PM at Drawing Room, Lobby

facts.text: The resort has an outdoor infinity pool and a children's pool.
facts.excerpt: Outdoor Infinity Pool

facts.text: Spa treatments are infused with tropical botanicals.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in treatments infused with tropical botanicals and unwind with personalised massages crafted to restore balance and serenity.

facts.text: The resort offers the St. Regis Butler Service.
facts.excerpt: Our beachfront accommodation in Langkawi offers signature butler service and turndown service.

facts.text: Langkawi International Airport is approximately 12.6 km from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: LGK is located approximately 12.6 KM from the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service; a private transfer is available for a fee with reservation required.
facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at The St. Regis Langkawi.

facts.text: Guests are encouraged to dress in a smart casual style.
facts.excerpt: We encourage our guests to dress in a smart casual style so as to remain comfortable from breakfast through dinner.

facts.text: Self parking and valet parking are complimentary for guests.
facts.excerpt: Self parking is complimentary for guests. Valet parking is complimentary for guests.

facts.text: The hotel opened in April 2016.
facts.excerpt: Opened April 2016.

facts.text: The hotel was named in Conde Nast Traveler's Readers' Choice Awards 2022.
facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2022

facts.text: The hotel calls Kayuputi's location the best sunset on the island.
facts.excerpt: The specialty over-water restaurant at our luxury hotel in Langkawi​ has the best sunset on the island

facts.text: Room and villa counts differ across pages.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel's 5-star accommodation features a collection of 89 suites and over-water villas.

contradictions.note: p1 says 89 suites and over-water villas and also 4 villas plus 85 rooms; p4 lists 85 rooms

sources.excerpt: Our hotel's 5-star accommodation features a collection of 89 suites and over-water villas.
